exposure: GDM management type (diet modification alone vs. insulin therapy)
cohort: The study involved 354 Filipino adult pregnant patients (180 with GDM and 174 without GDM) admitted for delivery at a tertiary hospital between January 2016 and May 2022.
finding: Third trimester fetal abdominal circumference was significantly larger in women with GDM compared to non-GDM women, regardless of the GDM management method.
mod_finding: The GDM group had significantly higher rates of cesarean section delivery (70%) compared to the non-GDM group (46.55%).
gest_age: The GDM group had neonates with a lower median age of gestation at birth (38 weeks) compared to the non-GDM group (39 weeks).
